description: Otbasy mortgage estimate / ипотека Отбасы банк / Отбасы банк ипотекасы. Estimates the two-stage housing loan of Otbasy Bank under the "Nauryz" and "Otau" programs: the checks on deposit, down payment and loan limit, the monthly payment of stage 1 (preliminary loan, 8 years: interest plus savings), and the stage 2 payment range (housing loan, 11 years, 3.5%–5.0%). It is a formula estimate, not the bank's schedule: the stage 2 rate depends on the bank's accumulated score, the 20% state premium and the deposit term. Loan limits depend on the region: 36 million KZT for Astana and Almaty, 30 million KZT for other regions.

down_payment_kzt.description: Own down payment and savings (housing savings deposit and ENPF funds included), in whole tenge. Must be below the property value.

is_susn.description: Socially vulnerable category (СУСН): stage 1 rate 7% instead of 9%.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

property_type.description: "primary_raw": new build with rough finish or share construction (down payment 20%). "primary_finished": new build with finish (10% under "Nauryz"; 20% under "Otau"). "secondary": resale home, allowed only in certain locations.

property_value_kzt.description: Price of the home, in whole tenge (KZT).

region.description: "major": Astana or Almaty (loan limit 36 million KZT). "other": any other region (30 million KZT).

title: Otbasy Bank "Nauryz" / "Otau" two-stage housing loan (2026)
